CREATE TABLE feeds (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('active', 'paused')),
    deleted_at TEXT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE feed_revisions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    feed_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES feeds(id),
    revision_number BIGINT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
    desired_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(desired_outcome)) > 0),
    general_instructions TEXT NULL,
    refresh_instructions TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(refresh_instructions)) > 0),
    card_instructions TEXT NULL,
    execution_instructions TEXT NULL,
    compounding_instructions TEXT NULL,
    instruction_revision_public_id TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (feed_id, revision_number)
);
CREATE TABLE sources (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    feed_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES feeds(id),
    checkpoint TEXT NULL,
    checkpoint_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    deleted_at TEXT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE source_revisions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    revision_number BIGINT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
    description TEXT NULL,
    general_instructions TEXT NULL,
    refresh_instructions TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(refresh_instructions)) > 0),
    card_instructions TEXT NULL,
    execution_instructions TEXT NULL,
    compounding_instructions TEXT NULL,
    instruction_revision_public_id TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (source_id, revision_number)
);
CREATE TABLE events (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    feed_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES feeds(id),
    card_id TEXT NULL,
    subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('feed', 'source', 'refresh', 'card', 'instance')),
    subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('feed_owner', 'agent', 'worker', 'operator', 'conveyor')),
    actor_identifier TEXT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'failed')),
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_identity TEXT NULL,
    correlation_id TEXT NULL,
    is_feed_owner_visible INTEGER NULL,
    activity_summary TEXT NULL,
    activity_detail TEXT NULL,
    is_audit_visible INTEGER NULL,
    audit_metadata TEXT NULL,
    reverses_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES events(id)
);

CREATE TABLE refreshes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    feed_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES feeds(id),
    feed_revision_id TEXT NULL,
    requested_by_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (requested_by_type IN ('feed_owner', 'worker')),
    requested_by_identifier TEXT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'working', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled')),
    claim_generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    claim_request_identity TEXT NULL,
    claim_expires_at TEXT NULL,
    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT NULL,
    is_quiet INTEGER NULL,
    terminal_reason TEXT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refreshes_one_in_flight_per_feed
    ON refreshes (feed_id)
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'working');

CREATE TABLE cards (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    feed_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES feeds(id),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('review', 'queued', 'working', 'done', 'superseded')),
    version BIGINT NOT NULL,
    state_changed_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE source_records (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    public_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    source_attempt_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES source_attempts(id),
    work_attempt_id TEXT NULL,
    external_record_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(external_record_key)) > 0),
    external_version TEXT NULL,
    locator TEXT NULL,
    content_digest TEXT NULL,
    evidence_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((source_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND work_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (source_attempt_id IS NULL AND work_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE TABLE card_revisions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id),
    origin_refresh_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES refreshes(id),
    origin_work_attempt_id TEXT NULL,
    request_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
    submission_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision_number BIGINT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0),
    matter TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(matter)) > 0),
    why_it_matters TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(why_it_matters)) > 0),
    importance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (importance IN ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'critical')),
    urgency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (urgency IN ('routine', 'soon', 'immediate', 'overdue')),
    review_blocks TEXT NOT NULL,
    work_next_steps TEXT NULL,
    requested_work TEXT NULL,
    work_feed_revision_id TEXT NULL,
    work_source_revision_ids TEXT NULL,
    source_record_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating_value TEXT NULL CHECK (rating_value IN ('thumbs_up', 'thumbs_down')),
    rating_reason TEXT NULL,
    rated_at TEXT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (card_id, revision_number),
    CHECK ((origin_refresh_id IS NOT NULL AND origin_work_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (origin_refresh_id IS NULL AND origin_work_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX card_revisions_refresh_identity
    ON card_revisions (origin_refresh_id, request_identity)
    WHERE origin_refresh_id IS NOT NULL;
